title: Workspace layer (private): one Linear workspace
description: Stored as workspaces/<slug>.json. Credentials are referenced by environment-variable name or credential-cache path, never stored.

refresh_command.description: How the operator refreshes the OAuth credential in credentials_file; named in preflight and in the stop for an expired credential (default: a short `codex exec`).

min_lifetime_minutes.description: Launch preflight fails when the OAuth credential in credentials_file expires sooner than this (default 30).

warn_lifetime_minutes.description: Launch preflight warns when the OAuth credential in credentials_file expires sooner than this (default 720).

assignee.description: "me" or an exact Linear user name/display name/email; resolved to an ID at dry-run/preflight.

attention.description: How the owner is addressed and how an issue that needs input is marked; outside the configuration fingerprint.

issue_template.description: The Linear issue template "Runner issue contract" recorded by runner.py sync-linear-template; not part of the batch configuration.
